Name: Monster Musk Extended
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[u][b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b][/u]

This is a simple mod that extends the efficacy of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Monster_Musk]monster musk[/url].

The specific changes it makes regarding monster musk are:

[list]
[*]doubling monster spawn chance by x2 in the mine quarry cave (area 77377)[/*]
[*]checking bug spawn tiles in bug land twice[/*]
[*]doubling the number of tiles to check for lava lurk spawns in the volcano[/*]
[/list]The wiki is a little bit incorrect in saying that monster musk doesn't affect the volcano; according to the game code, it does affect all monster spawns except lava lurks, which this mod tries to correct.

The number of pawn tiles in a map still limit potential numbers of spawns, but you should still see an increase in most cases.


[u][b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b][/u]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Translations should use config variable names as the keys, adding .Desc to the end of the key for hover descriptions.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
